title: chore(spec): drop the stale "No backticks in surface" comments from semantic migration entries
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoDhJuq8ADMbr6jHaGGQCs9S)_
Fixes #27731

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:删掉 223 个语义迁移条目里那句过时的「`surface` 里不许写反引号」注释,并删掉 `compliance-families-retirement.test.ts` 里同一理由的那条断言。
- 为什么改:升级指南的渲染器已改为按 CommonMark 规则给 `surface` 加围栏,反引号能正确渲染;这些注释与断言描述的限制已不存在,会误导下一个作者。
- 风险与回滚:只动注释行和一条测试断言,任何条目数据(surface/replacement/reason/acceptanceCriteria)一字未动,已用脚本逐条比对证明;不发布任何字节;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.filter-is-empty-lowers-to-empty-operator.ts`(唯一保留半句的文件)、`packages/spec/src/system/compliance-families-retirement.test.ts`、`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/17.spec-type-alias-input-suffix-retired.ts`(这条过时说法的源头)。
- 两分钟验证:`git grep -c -i "No backticks" -- packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic | wc -l`,预期输出 0。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **223 semantic migration entries** under `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/` lose the workaround comment that said a `surface` must carry no backticks (and, in some spellings, no pipes) because the upgrade guide renders it inside a code span and a table cell. That is no longer true: `build-upgrade-guide.ts` fences every surface through `scripts/lib/markdown-code-span.ts` (CommonMark 6.1), and a semantic surface renders in a list item, not a table row (the conversion table escapes pipes per cell anyway).
  - 222 files carry the "No backticks" spelling (the card counted 219 at `ef359b95`; new entries landed since). The 223rd is `17.spec-type-alias-input-suffix-retired.ts`, whose "Plain text, no markdown … backticks here break both" note is the one the others point to ("see the note on `spec-type-alias-input-suffix-retired`"), so it goes too.
  - 216 files: the comment was its own paragraph, removed together with one adjacent blank `//` separator. 6 files: it was the trailing sentence of a longer paragraph, so only that sentence is cut. 1 file (`18.filter-is-empty-lowers-to-empty-operator.ts`): the comment also carried a still-true rule (no `' / '` in a surface, because the schema build splits clauses on it, see `minRegisteredMajorForLeaf`); that half is kept, reworded to stand alone.
- **`packages/spec/src/system/compliance-families-retirement.test.ts`**: the remaining `expect(entry.surface).not.toMatch(...)` no-backtick assertion and its stated reason are dropped. The order said a grep for `BACKTICK` at `3d9175d0` found nothing; that is because the card spelled the regex out in words. The assertion itself (a literal backtick regex) was still there at `501c864d`, measured and removed.
- **No generator or template emits the comment**: `git grep -i "no backticks"` outside the entries hits only unrelated text (`docker/Dockerfile`, `scripts/check-regen-pending.mjs`, `scripts/symbol-anchors.mjs`, an mcp test); no script under `scripts/` or `packages/spec/scripts/` and no skill writes an entry template carrying it.
- No line-number anchor points into these files (`git grep` for `entries/semantic/...ts:N` finds none), so no ledger drifts.

## Tests

- Proof that only comments moved (script kept out of the tree): for each of the 223 changed entry files, the TypeScript AST printed with `removeComments` at base `501c864d` equals the one at head: **223/223 identical**. Then each entry module was imported from both trees and the whole `entry` object compared as JSON (id, surface, replacement, reason, acceptanceCriteria and every other key; 1147 keys): **223/223 identical**.
- Negative control: with one surface changed by one prefix in `18.page-slots-tabs-retired.ts` (committed, measured, reset), both comparisons report **222/223** and name that file; the tree was restored (`git status` clean).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/system/compliance-families-retirement.test.ts src/migrations` at `3737a157`: Test Files 6 passed (6), Tests 204 passed (204).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` at `3737a157`: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **No changeset** (`skip-changeset`): nothing published moves. `@objectstack/spec` `files[]` ships `dist`, `src/**/*.zod.ts` and generated artifacts; the entries are `*.ts` (not `.zod.ts`) and the test is `.test.ts`. After a full build at `3737a157`, `grep -rlF "No backticks"` and `grep -rlF "Plain text, no markdown"` over every `files[]` path hit 0 files, while the positive control (`SqlDriver.distinct() third argument`, an entry surface) hits 2 files in `dist`.
- No governed path in the diff (all paths are under `packages/spec/src/`).
- The order's 222-file measurement held; the 223rd file is the same workaround in different words, inside the order's file surface (comment lines in `entries/semantic/**`).

## Verification

Head `3737a157`, base `501c864d`. Full workspace build first (`pnpm turbo run build --filter='!@objectstack/docs' --concurrency=2`, real `.d.ts`): 116/116 tasks.
